items.title: Experience design and strategy
items.subtitle: UX + Product Design
items.shortDescription: We design clear, useful, and human-centered digital experiences, connecting user needs with business goals.
items.longDescription:
This service helps companies and product teams better understand their users, identify real problems, streamline digital experiences, and design solutions that are easy to use, viable to build, and aligned with business strategy.

We work from research and problem definition to information architecture, user flows, wireframes, UI design, interactive prototypes, and documentation for development.

The goal is to create simpler, more efficient digital products ready to improve conversion, adoption, and user satisfaction.
forWho: Startups needing to design or improve their digital product.
Companies looking to optimize platforms, websites, apps, or internal systems.
Product leaders needing clarity to make decisions.
Tech teams requiring better UX/UI definitions before development.
Agencies needing specialized support in user experience.
Organizations looking to improve the usability, conversion, or satisfaction of their users.

items.title: MVP prototyping and coding
items.subtitle: Digital Products
items.shortDescription: We turn ideas and designs into functional prototypes or digital MVPs to validate, learn, and move faster to market.
items.longDescription: This service is aimed at companies, startups, and teams that need to transition from an idea, wireframe, or design to a functional version of the product.\n\nWe design and build interactive prototypes, landing pages, MVPs, and early versions of digital products using modern technologies and agile processes. The focus is on creating a solution robust enough to validate the model, test the experience, get real feedback, and pave the way for future development stages.
forWho: Startups needing to launch an MVP quickly.
Companies wanting to validate a new idea before investing in full development.
Founders who need to show a functional version to users, partners, or investors.
Innovation teams requiring prototypes for internal pilots.
Agencies or consultancies needing support to materialize digital products.
Product teams wanting to accelerate proofs of concept.

items.question: What does Rukma Studio do?
items.answer: Rukma Studio helps companies, startups, and digital teams design, validate, and build digital products. We work on UX strategy, Product Design, MVP prototyping, interface design, brand identity, and guidance to turn ideas into real solutions.

items.question: At what stage of the project can you help us?
items.answer:
We can assist from early stages, when there is only an idea or problem to solve, to more advanced stages where a product already exists and needs to improve its experience, conversion, usability, or visual identity.

We can also participate in specific processes such as UX audits, redesigns, prototypes, MVPs, validations, or designing new features.

items.question: Do you only do design or also development?
items.answer:
We mainly work on strategy, UX, Product Design, and digital identity, but we can also assist in functional prototyping, front-end, MVPs, and building early versions of digital products.

The level of development depends on the project scope, required technologies, and validation goals.

items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer:
It depends on the type of service and the complexity of the project.

As a reference:
• A UX diagnostic can take between 1 and 3 weeks.
• A UX/UI design process can take between 4 and 8 weeks.
• A functional MVP can take between 3 and 10 weeks.
• An identity project can take between 3 and 6 weeks.

Final timelines are defined after reviewing objectives, scope, content, features, and the required depth.

items.question: Do you work with startups or only companies?
items.answer:
We work with both profiles.

We can help startups that need to validate an idea, design their MVP, or prepare a stronger pitch. We also work with companies that need to improve existing products, streamline digital processes, redesign platforms, or create new experiences for their customers and internal teams.

items.question: What do we need to get started?
items.answer:
To get started, we need to understand the project context, business objectives, current state of the solution, involved users, and the main needs or problems identified.

It is not necessary to have everything figured out. We can help you organize the information, define priorities, and build a clear roadmap to move forward.

audience.title: FUNDS & ACCELERATORS
